title: WPSS/2378/2023 of SESHNATH RAI Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

COURT'S OR JUDGES'S ORDERS
WPSS No.2378 of 2023
Hon'ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Anil Anthwal, learned counsel holding
brief of Mr. Anand Kumar Pandey, learned counsel
for the petitioner.
2. Mr. V.S. Rawat, learned Brief Holder with
Mr. Jayvardhan Kandpal, learned Brief Holder
(through video conferencing) for the State.
3. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
4. The petitioner has sought the indulgence of
this Court for a direction to the respondents to
permit him to join in the department pursuant to the
appointment order dated 21.04.2023 on the post of
Nursery Development Officer, Rudrapur, District
Udham Singh Nagar.
5. It is the case of the petitioner that father of
the petitioner was in regular service with
respondent-department, who expired during service
in the year 2021 leaving behind the petitioner, his
mother and one married sister. By appointment
letter dated 21.04.2023, the petitioner was given
appointment on the aforesaid post on
compassionate ground.
6. The grievance of the petitioner is that even
after the appointment, having been offered to him,
he has not been permitted to join on the said post.

7. Learned counsel for the State on instruction,
submitted that after appointment, having been
offered, to the petitioner on 23.05.2023, the
petitioner was informed by the respondent-department that he would be given joining only
after the verification of his educational
testimonials/documents.
8. According to the learned State Counsel the
verification of the documents of the petitioner is
still going on and the petitioner is called for
verification and reply on 27.01.2024 in the office of
the Director at Chaubatiya, Ranikhet.
9. Since the verification of the documents of the
petitioner is still pending, the writ petition appears
to be pre-mature one.
10. Accordingly, the writ petition, being pre-mature, is dismissed.
11. The petitioner may file fresh writ petition for
redressal of his grievance, if any cause of action
arises.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 06.01.2024
